set.body: Acceptance criteria: provide a small workflow surface from import through validation, synchronization, visual degrees, preprocessing, detection, trial/AOI measurement, and tidy results while retaining expert module APIs; every stage directly exposes report, warnings, provenance, and explain; public vocabulary is readable without weakening units, frame, clock, or failure semantics; documentation begins with a compiled five-minute real-data workflow, then mental model, ingest, time/space transforms, preprocessing, detector cards, AOIs, comparisons, reproducibility, and extension guidance; long rationale moves to ADRs; examples compile in CI.
set.title: Psychology-facing workflow facade and task-first documentation
